name: Deposit: Success
description: Characterize Legacy deposit success including DB, outbound calls, and shared resources.

queries.name: main_wallets
queries.sql: SELECT w.id, w.balance, w.freeze FROM wallets w JOIN users u ON u.id=w.user_id JOIN stations s ON s.id=u.station_id WHERE u.account=? AND s.code=? AND w.platform_name='main' AND w.currency='TWD' ORDER BY w.id

queries.name: game_wallet
queries.sql: SELECT w.balance, w.freeze FROM wallets w JOIN users u ON u.id=w.user_id WHERE u.account=? AND w.platform_name='sbo' AND w.currency='TWD'

queries.name: order
queries.sql: SELECT trade_no, wallet_id, amount, status, stage, error_code, error_message FROM deposit_records WHERE trade_no=? ORDER BY id

queries.name: transactions
queries.sql: SELECT t.model_type, t.model_id, t.wallet_id, COALESCE(d.trade_no, w.trade_no) AS linked_trade_no, CASE WHEN t.model_no = COALESCE(d.no, w.no) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS model_no_matches_order, CASE WHEN t.wallet_id = COALESCE(d.wallet_id, w.wallet_id) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS wallet_id_matches_order, t.platform_name, t.type, t.trade_type, t.currency, t.balance_original, t.balance_variable, t.balance_complete FROM transactions t JOIN users u ON u.id = t.user_id JOIN stations s ON s.id = u.station_id LEFT JOIN deposit_records d ON t.type = 'deposit' AND d.id = t.model_id AND d.user_id = t.user_id LEFT JOIN withdrawal_records w ON t.type = 'withdrawal' AND w.id = t.model_id AND w.user_id = t.user_id WHERE u.account = ? AND s.code = ? ORDER BY t.id

queries.name: activity_log
queries.sql: SELECT log_name, description, subject_type, subject_id, event, JSON_VALUE(properties, '$.attributes.wallet_id') AS wallet_id, JSON_VALUE(properties, '$.attributes.trade_type') AS trade_type, JSON_VALUE(properties, '$.attributes.balance_variable') AS balance_variable, JSON_VALUE(properties, '$.old.balance') AS old_balance, JSON_VALUE(properties, '$.attributes.balance') AS new_balance, JSON_VALUE(properties, '$.old.status') AS old_status, JSON_VALUE(properties, '$.attributes.status') AS new_status, JSON_VALUE(properties, '$.old.stage') AS old_stage, JSON_VALUE(properties, '$.attributes.stage') AS new_stage FROM activity_log ORDER BY id

queries.name: remittance
queries.sql: SELECT type, amount, status, stage FROM remittance_records WHERE user_id=(SELECT id FROM users WHERE account=?) ORDER BY id
